The ego vehicle is traveling at 50 kph with a visibility range of only 18 m, while a static obstacle is located at 25.4 m ahead. Since the obstacle is currently outside the visibility range, the ego vehicle cannot perceive it in time to execute a full stop or safe maneuver without potentially causing a rear-end collision or erratic behavior. The appropriate action is to decelerate (A1) to reduce speed, thereby decreasing the stopping distance and increasing the time available to react once the obstacle enters the visibility range or if the driver perceives it through other means, ensuring safety in a visibility-limited condition.
